walkthroughs.body_html:
E-commerce means buying and selling online.

Amazon, eBay, Vinted and Etsy are huge marketplaces — millions of sellers, billions of buyers.

Online markets are:

  • Open 24/7.
  • Global — sell anywhere.
  • Easy to compare prices.
  • Full of reviews.

One bad review can sink a seller. 😬

Sellers must plan delivery — often free, often fast.

UK law gives buyers 14 days to return most online goods. Returns cost businesses billions. 📦
